Subject: Partner credit request for HelioRetail sandbox pilot

Hi Michael,

Quick ask from the CrestWorks partnerships team — we have a joint pilot with HelioRetail that needs extended sandbox credits to run a merchant-import + end-to-end recommendation PoC. Current sandbox quota expires next week; the customer asked if we can top up partner-sourced marketplace/promotional credits so they can complete the data ingestion and two weeks of heavy evaluation (spike load testing + rerank evals).

Summary:
- Customer: HelioRetail (retail analytics)
- Request: $10,000 marketplace promo credit (partner-sourced)
- Timing: need allocation by 24 Jun to avoid interruption
- Usage estimate: ~200k tokens over 2 weeks, with ~30k tokens/day peak during import and evaluation runs
- Compliance: customer ok with audit logs and has completed our basic security questionnaire (attestation attached in the XLSX)

Attaching our voucher request workbook (crestworks_voucher_request.xlsx) with cost breakdown and the proposed split between sandbox/PoC environments. Can you endorse and route to partner ops for final approval? If we can get a short conditional approval (capped usage + 90-day expiry) that would unblock the pilot.

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful — Lena (CrestWorks)

--
Lena Ortiz

Thanks for the ping, Michael. Reviewed CrestWorks' request and the attached workbook. My recommendation: approve a $10k marketplace promotional voucher with the following operational constraints:

- TTL: 90 days from issuance
- Allocation: 60% sandbox (ingest/ETL & test runs) / 40% PoC (inference + rerank workloads)
- Daily cap: 40k tokens/day (enforced via routing policy)
- Audit/logs: customer must enable debug-level logs for import window; partner to provide confirmation by email
- Rebilling: voucher consumes marketplace credits and will not be refundable; any overages revert to standard billing for the account

I've attached the marketplace voucher terms (marketplace_voucher_terms.pdf) — please confirm legal/finance ok with the TTL and non-refundable clause. Vanessa — can you check capacity for a voucher issuance next week and reserve a placeholder code? Also please create a HubSpot activity referencing RW-DEAL-83421 so we can track usage and expiration.

Action items:
- Vanessa: reserve voucher code + confirm issuance flow and quota (ETA: EOD 18 Jun)
- CrestWorks (Lena): confirm audit/log acceptance + sign DocuSign scope so we can issue
- Michael: final endorse once Vanessa confirms ops readiness

Thanks — Soojin
